caption:
Figure 1: Motivation for semantic routing under pose uncertainty. Pose errors weaken the spatial
correspondence used by alignment-based cross-view fusion, motivating CVRoute to associate street-
view semantic evidence with satellite regions through learned cross-view relationships.
